title: Interpolation
text: Interpolate values of real input samples, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Interpolation points} sets Interpolation points [1.1 4.8 2.67 1.6; {Source of interpolation points} sets the interpolation point input method Specify via, {Interpolation mode}, {Interpolation filter half-length} sets the half length of FIR interpolation filter, {Interpolation points per input sample} sets the interpolation points per sample, {Normalized input bandwidth} and {Out of range interpolation points} sets the error handling for out-of-range points. Values come from the instance.
